chat_enabled.description: Off switch for chat (ADR-027). Operators flip it; Terraform only creates it, with chat off.

active_index.description: Name of the live vector index, or 'none' before Phase 5 (ADR-019). Changed only by index promotion.

llm_config.description: Provider and model as one coherent value (ADR-021). Must be a validated pair; changed by model promotion.

limits.description: Request caps, rate limits, and quotas. Provisional values from docs/operations/abuse-budgets.md.

turnstile_secret.note: The name is provisioned by Terraform in Phase 4. The value is injected out of band and never appears in source, plans, outputs, or logs (ADR-023, R-18).
